parameters.name: DefenceMode
parameters.description:
The prevention mode. Valid values:

*   **block**: Interception Mode
*   **audit**: Alert Mode

parameters.name: Dir
parameters.description: The directory for which you want to enable web tamper proofing. Separate multiple directories with commas (,).

parameters.name: ExclusiveDir
parameters.description:
The directory for which you want to disable web tamper proofing.

> If you set **Mode** to **blacklist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: ExclusiveFile
parameters.description:
The file for which you want to disable web tamper proofing.

> If you set **Mode** to **blacklist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: ExclusiveFileType
parameters.description:
The type of the file for which you want to disable web tamper proofing. Separate multiple types with semicolons (;). Valid values:

*   php
*   jsp
*   asp
*   aspx
*   js
*   cgi
*   html
*   htm
*   xml
*   shtml
*   shtm
*   jpg
*   gif
*   png

> If you set **Mode** to **blacklist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: InclusiveFileType
parameters.description:
The type of the file for which you want to enable web tamper proofing. Separate multiple types with semicolons (;). Valid values:

*   php
*   jsp
*   asp
*   aspx
*   js
*   cgi
*   html
*   htm
*   xml
*   shtml
*   shtm
*   jpg
*   gif
*   png

> If you set **Mode** to **whitelist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: LocalBackupDir
parameters.description:
The local path to the backup files of the protected directory.\
The directory format of a Linux server is different from that of a Windows server. You must enter the directory in the required format based on your operating system. Examples:

*   Linux server: /usr/local/aegis/bak
*   Windows server: C:\Program Files (x86)\Alibaba\Aegis\bak

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The protection mode of web tamper proofing. Valid values:

*   **whitelist**: In this mode, web tamper proofing is enabled for the specified directories and file types.
*   **blacklist**: In this mode, web tamper proofing is enabled for the unspecified subdirectories, file types, and files in the protected directory.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server for which you want to enable web tamper proofing.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-start --biz-mode whitelist --local-backup-dir /usr/local/backup --exclusive-file /home/admin/tomcat/localhost.log --dir /home/admin/tomcat --inclusive-file-type php --uuid 80d2f7d6-31a9-4d7f-8ff4-7ecc42f89ca0000 --exclusive-file-type jpg --exclusive-dir /home/admin/java --defence-mode block --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyWebLockStart --region cn-hangzhou --InclusiveFileType php --ExclusiveFile '/home/admin/tomcat/localhost.log' --Uuid '80d2f7d6-31a9-4d7f-8ff4-7ecc42f89ca0000' --ExclusiveDir '/home/admin/java' --DefenceMode block --Mode whitelist --LocalBackupDir '/usr/local/backup' --ExclusiveFileType jpg --Dir '/home/admin/tomcat'
